title: ConSPYration
description:
Welcome to the thrilling world of ConSPYration, a spy-themed local multiplayer for up to 6 players. In this high-stakes espionage showdown, your mission is clear: steal the briefcase and race to the exit before your opponents do. Whether you choose to collaborate as teams or engage in an all-out free-for-all, ConSPYration delivers heart-pounding action in every stage, each filled with its own unique gimmicks and devious obstacles.

Your objective is to remain undetected, collect the briefcase and race to the exit. But beware - rival spies can swipe the briefcase right out of your hands! Be quick to steal it back!

Prepare to navigate a series of complex stages, each brimming with clever traps and formidable obstacles that will put your espionage skills to the test. Adapt, strategize, and overcome these challenges to achieve your mission objective.

ConSPYration offers a variety of playable characters, team colors, and control options for you to play how you want. With shared keyboard play and gamepad support, gather your friends and embark on this clandestine operation together!

With support for up to 4 players on a single keyboard, you can use a variety of key configurations, including WASD, IJKL, numpad, and arrow keys. Up to 6 players can use gamepads at a time. Across keyboard and controllers, everyone can jump in on the action!

Notice: Local Multiplayer only. Online multiplayer is supported through steam's Remote Play Together.
